submission.reasoning: This is normal Ubuntu login-banner (MOTD) generation, not an attack. The chain was: env -i ... run-parts --lsbsysinit /etc/update-motd.d (root), then /bin/sh /etc/update-motd.d/95-hwe-eol, a stock Ubuntu script that checks hardware-enablement end-of-life, then rm -f /var/lib/update-notifier/tmp.aHJK3eQBrz. The rm only deleted that script's own temporary file inside update-notifier's directory. The whole chain ran in under half a second and matches stock Ubuntu behaviour. Nothing points to deletion of logs or evidence, and no unusual parent process is involved.
